none: PAS CAM-0C9647: Greek & Roman Provincial Coin: Egyptian tetradrachm of Salonina
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy Egyptian tetradrachm of Salonina dating to the period AD 260 to 268. cf Milne p. 147, no. 1640. Obverse shows Draped bust right. Obverse legend reads KOPNHLIA CALWNEINA CEB. Apologies for the Greek transcription - can't get Greek characters here. Reverse shows Eagle standing, wing open left, wreath in beak; to right palm; to left LID. Die axis is 12 o'clock, weight is 10.21g,…
